items.headline: Manchester United lose 2-0 to Hull City in Premier League season opener
items.summary: Hull City defeated Manchester United 2-0 in their opening Premier League match. Goals from Semi Ajayi and Nobel Mendy in the first half left United under pressure early in the season.

items.headline: United face Ipswich Town in second Premier League match of season
items.summary: Manchester United prepare for their visit to Ipswich Town following the disappointing opening-day defeat at Hull City.
